title: Naito finally gets his Tokyo Dome roll call
summary: Naito seeks the complete Tokyo Dome celebration denied to him in 2020. A G1 victory leads him to a championship match against his former LIJ partner SANADA.

chapters.title: One more G1 victory
chapters.result: Naito defeats Okada to win the G1.
chapters.context: The veteran earns another Dome main event and a chance to finish his interrupted celebration.

chapters.title: SANADA saves Naito’s celebration
chapters.result: Naito defeats SANADA; SANADA then stops EVIL and Togo’s attack.
chapters.context: The defeated former teammate allows Naito to complete his LIJ roll call, reversing the interruption that followed his 2020 triumph.
